Generated Narrative: CodeSystem condition-severity-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.dha.go.ke/ig/patient-summary/CodeSystem/condition-severity-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
MILD MildThe condition has a mild impact on the patient's daily activities.
MODERATE ModerateThe condition has a moderate impact on the patient's daily activities.
SEVERE SevereThe condition has a severe impact on the patient's daily activities.
LIFE-THREATENING Life ThreateningThe condition is immediately life threatening.
